title: Fourier coefficient of the zero function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of the real-valued functions on $\Omega$, indexed by $\iota$, whose zero-indexed vector is constant one and whose vectors are orthonormal for the inner product weighted by $\pi$. For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, the Fourier coefficient of the zero function on $\Omega^n$ at $a$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: Basis $B$ of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ with constant-one zero-indexed vector
Orthonormality of the basis for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
